items.question: What is milestone-M2?
items.answer: Building Health Information Provider (HIP) services to link digital health records with ABHA and share digital records via Personal Health Records (ABHA) app.

items.question: Who can become a HIP?
items.answer: Any entity that generates digital health records will be eligible to become a HIP. Eg- A doctor at a health care organization; a health care organization.

items.question: What is a PHR application?
items.answer: PHR application is a mobile app currently available on Android. It is a reference PHR application and market is expected to bring in innovative solutions. PHR application can help with creation of an ABHA address, linking & viewing of health records. PHR app also helps with user consent management.

items.question: What is X-HIP ID / X-HIU-ID / X-CM-ID and how to generate them?
items.answer:
Please refer the section, 'Register the Facility that your Repository services' available in link https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/docs/getting_started_with_apis which give the curl function to register the HIP and HIU service that your Repository (HRP) services. Using the curl function listed in this webpage will register the HIP or HIU Service.

 X-HIP-ID is obtained from HFR registration and Register as HIP service through the API 

X-HIU-ID is obtained from HFR registration and Register as HIU service through the API 

X-CM-ID is the - For sandbox = sbx , for Production =ndhm is an identifier for HIE-CM. Currently, there is one HIE-CM each, for Sandbox & Production. Hence, X-CM-ID for sandbox = sbx , for Production =ndhm 

NHA plans to release a paper on multiple consent manager ecosystem for public consultation shortly. ABHA ID will always need to be linked to a HIE-CM (Consent Manager) with a ABHA address in order to link health records. Users will then have the choice to choose a HIE-CM and every HIE-CM will have a domain. So, ABHA addresses will look like name@abdm or name@xyz or name@abc, etc

items.question: Where I can register our standard complient healthcare application for visibility and recognize?
items.answer: NRCeS has provided a common dashboard / info-location on NRCeS website where vendors / implementers / HSPs can provide self-declared details of their standard implementation status and other details. This platform will help vendors / implementers / HSPs get recognized at national as well as international level and many interested hospitals / clinics / agencies to know what is available and with whom. Register your standard complient healthcare application at https://www.nrces.in/registries/hcit-standard-registry

items.question: Will SNOMED CT provide daily dose limit, drug frequency for drugs like it provides the dosage form and route of administration?
items.answer: SNOMED CT provides the basic attribute depending on nature of concept. Intelligance in terms of advice/instruction or decision support can be build at application using the defined attributes present in SNOMED CT.

items.question: Where I can download Common Drug Codes for India (CDCI)?
items.answer: To download and get information about Common Drug Codes for India (CDCI), please visit at https://www.nrces.in/services/national-releases#drug_codes

items.question: What if patient does not share any ABHA Address with the health facility?
items.answer: If the patient visiting the health facility (onboarded on ABDM eco-system) does not have any ABHA address or number. Patient can then proceed to register by providing Name, DoB, Gender and Mobile. Patient may then proceed to get treatment and generation of health records. Health facility then notifies HIE-CM of a new health record for mobile number of the patient. No other details are shared, i.e, no details of health record type or patient demographic details are shared. On this mobile number, simply SMS is delivered informing visit of the patient to the health facility. This workflow is explained in detail on webpage, https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/docs/deep_linking_phr For additional details, may please refer section#5, 'Share Patient profile with HIP' on webpage https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/docs/build_hip

What are the different fetch modes available?
items.answer:
i) MOBILE\_OTP - for authentication to be initiated with user's registered mobile number.

 ii) AADHAAR\_OTP - for authentication to be initiated with AADHAAR registered mobile number.

 iii) DEMOGRAPHICS - authentication mode where HIPs are expected to send over user details exactly as registered with ABHA Number system.

 iv) DIRECT - this is a direct means of authentication with user.

 API to fetch supported authentication modes for a specified purposes = /v0.5/users/auth/fetch-modes

items.question: How FHIR and SNOMED CT linked?
items.answer: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) is a standard describing data formats and elements and an application programming interface (API) for exchanging electronic health records. While SNOMED CT is a systematically organized computer-processable collection of clinical terminologies providing codes, terms, synonyms, and definitions. SNOMED CT can be used while recording the clinical details of individuals in electronic records. In FHIR, many elements in resources have a coded value, where SNOMED CT terminology can be referred to document clinical content in a standardized format and to achieve semantic interoperability.

items.question: Do I need a license to use SNOMED CT in India ? What does it cost?
items.answer: Yes, an Affiliate License is required for use of SNOMED CT in India. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoH&FW), Government of India has made SNOMED CT freely available for all use within India.

items.question: How to browse SNOMED CT content?
items.answer: SNOMED CT content can be browsed using freely available online browsers Suggested browsers 1. 1\. SNOMED International SNOMED CT Browser -  https://browser.ihtsdotools.org/ 2. 2\. C-DAC's CSNOFinder

items.question: SNOMED CT is free to be used in India, then do I still need to procure the Affiliate License?
items.answer: Yes, you still need to procure license for SNOMED CT as it is an intellectual property of SNOMED International and there are certain terms and conditions for usage of SNOMED CT as mentioned in Affiliate License Agreement. For more details, refer Get SNOMED CT section of SNOMED International website.
